title: Analysis code for: Thyroid function and atherosclerotic vascular disease — Mendelian randomization estimates depend substantially on the outcome GWAS used
description:
Two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis pipeline for three thyroid function traits (hypothyroidism, TSH, free T4) against eight atherosclerotic vascular outcomes.

Includes: LD clumping and instrument selection; harmonisation with strand-complement handling; primary MR (Wald, IVW fixed/random, MR-Egger, weighted median, weighted mode, Cochran's Q, MR-PRESSO-equivalent outlier detection, leave-one-out, directionality); independent replication in MVP and FinnGen R13; pan-vascular spectrum extension; reverse MR; multivariable MR; colocalisation (pure-Python coloc.abf); power analysis and outcome-scale screening; and the reverse application of the sample-overlap analytic framework of Burgess, Davies & Thompson (2016).

No methodological novelty is claimed for the analytic framework — it is adopted from Burgess et al. (2016), Genet Epidemiol 40:597-608, PMID 27625185, DOI 10.1002/gepi.21998, and applied in reverse.

Note: raw GWAS summary statistics are third-party public data and are not redistributed here; all accessions are listed in DATA_SOURCES.md.
